# Making Of

## 01

You are an experienced software developer with a deep understanding of programming languages, development frameworks, and best practices - specifically with .NET 10 C#.

We will be building a desktop application using .NET 10 C# that will be used to manage and track a collection of playing cards.

For now, I would like to focus on a basic user interface.

The interface should display cards in a grid format, with each card represented by a visual element that includes the card's image, name, and any relevant details. The grid should be scrollable if the number of cards exceeds the visible area, and it should allow for easy selection and interaction with individual cards.
